description: I'm a Software Engineering student from Pilsen, Czech Republic. I like building apps that solve concrete problems, from a thoughtful interface through to the backend and database that hold it together.
It's not just about making it work, but also thinking about why it works and what makes it a product people will actually want to use.

about.intro: Full-stack Engineer and Software Engineering student. I build web applications with attention to architecture, interface quality, and getting products into production.
about.quote: I like projects where careful engineering and a clear interface meet something people will actually use.
whoIAm: I'm a software engineering student who builds interactive products and web experiences.
Most of my work sits in React, Next.js, and Spring Boot, and I spend a growing share of my time on backend design and system architecture.
outsideOfCode: Several of my personal projects come from communities and games I've spent time in, including OMORI Headspace and OMORI Wordle.
